name: What is the average cost of window replacement in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of window replacement in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window replacement in Orange County varies significantly based on several factors: the type of window (e.g., vinyl, wood, fiberglass), the style (e.g., double-hung, casement, picture), the number of windows, their size, and any special features like energy-efficient coatings or custom shapes. Installation labor costs also play a role. Generally, homeowners can expect to invest anywhere from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars per window, including installation. We provide detailed, no-obligation quotes after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: The average cost of window replacement in Orange County varies based on window type, style, number, size, features, and labor, typically ranging from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars per window.
